extraction.disclaimer_span: We do not offer every plan available in your area. Currently we represent 26 organizations which offer 3,740 products in your area. Please contact Medicare.gov or 1-800-MEDICARE to get information on all of your options.
extraction.benefits_span: Let me check the network for your primary care physician.
extraction.soa_span: Can you sign it while we're on the line?

superlatives.text: The Mutual of Omaha plan available in Duval County has a $40 monthly premium, a $310 drug deductible and a $5700 maximum out-of-pocket.

composition.summary: The call started with a required disclosure, followed by a discussion of benefits. The agent collected the Scope of Appointment and scheduled a follow-up appointment. No superlatives were flagged.
composition.coaching_note: Agent: 'Let me check the network for your primary care physician.' This is a good practice as it shows the agent is actively gathering information to provide the best possible service. Consider adding a brief introduction to the call to set expectations and gather more information upfront.
